description: This file defines the 'Parameter' class, which models the <parameter> XML element used in service configuration within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to access parameter name and value, and processes XML element attributes during object creation.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: A thread-safe class that encapsulates a service configuration parameter sourced from an XML element.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Parameter object from an XML Element, extracting 'name' and 'value' attributes and throwing exception if they are empty.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parameter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the parameter.
